title: Upgrade AI Cockpit governance

intent.problem: The adopter is on AI Cockpit 0.5.63 while the template's published 0.5.70 installation surface is available; the upgrade must also be checked against the template main branch feature catalog so no installer capability is omitted.
constraints: Use the adopter remote default branch origin/main at the recorded base commit.
Use the published v0.5.70 source identity pinned to commit 746329ced7a1d315a468d4e2c6a7a39d50bcc343; use template main only as the comparison baseline.

Preserve project-owned or diverged paths classified by the installer and retain the rollback backup until review; the only follow-up edit to a preserved guard is the narrow feature-checklist coverage association required by the repository coverage rule.
Do not change product source or perform automatic commit, push, PR, merge, or branch deletion.
intent.rationale: The official upgrade installer records the Work Item, ownership decisions, and rollback evidence; a catalog/runtime-surface comparison against main provides the requested item-by-item installation checklist evidence.

problemStatement: This is a mechanical governance upgrade. The current installed AI Cockpit release is 0.5.63; product-specific motivation was not provided.
outOfScope: Automatic commit, push, PR, merge, or branch deletion

sources.reason: Default-branch feature catalog and installation-surface comparison baseline.
Published immutable release source used for the upgrade; archive SHA-256 is recorded in the Summary.
Installer feature checklist: stack and script inventory.
Managed file diff and rollback evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: Upgrade replaces managed governance files and must remain reviewable and reversible.

reasons: Upgrade replaces managed governance and installer surfaces.

preReviewWarnings: Review managed-file diff, source/target versions, and rollback backup before commit.
acceptance: Upgrade creates an active Contract and Summary on a dedicated upgrade branch when a remote default branch is discoverable.
Contract/Summary record source and target versions, managed file changes, and rollback backup paths.
The installer feature checklist is compared item by item against template main: all catalog stacks/scripts, runtime Make targets, and on-disk entrypoints are accounted for.
Upgrade remains review-only: installer performs no commit, push, PR, merge, or branch deletion.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Published source and target version identity are recorded
Every installer feature-list entry is present and comparable with template main
evidence: main/current catalog parity: 13 stacks and 115 scripts
all 115 catalog scripts exist on disk and match the v0.5.70 source
19 runtime Make targets are present in Makefile.ai

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Project-owned divergence and rollback remain reviewable
Upgrade stays on the adopter main-based Work Item branch without Git publication
evidence: origin/HEAD points to origin/main and the Work Item branch was created from c12280bead071e07749541ba4823c95a86b04a2b
installer action log ends with install complete and contains no commit/push/PR/merge action

guidelines: Upgrade must fail closed when active Work Items exist unless --upgrade-with-active is explicit.
Rollback backups must remain available until the upgrade is reviewed.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized the complete implementation loop.

rollbackNote: Restore the recorded upgrade-backups directory and revert the Work Item branch.
